evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-verify — cross-validate scan findings, check workflow integrity, bidirectional consistency, và generate verified result
evals.expected_output: Creates .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-verify/[session]/ với 4 findings-crossref-*.json files, findings-workflow.json, findings-consistency.json, findings-masterplan-verify.json, audit-verified-result.json, verify-status.json, và report. Dedupes cross-source findings. Displays summary table với verdict.

assertions.text: .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-verify/[session]/verify-status.json is created with scope: 'all'
4 findings-crossref-*.json files created (agents-skills, skills-templates, docs, hooks) with $schema: 'audit-findings-v1'
.mc-data/work/audit-devkit-verify/[session]/findings-workflow.json created with $schema: 'audit-findings-v1'
.mc-data/work/audit-devkit-verify/[session]/findings-consistency.json created with $schema: 'audit-findings-v1'
.mc-data/work/audit-devkit-verify/[session]/findings-masterplan-verify.json created (rỗng hoặc có findings)
.mc-data/work/audit-devkit-verify/[session]/audit-verified-result.json created with $schema: 'audit-verified-result-v1'
audit-verified-result.json has summary.final_total = length of findings array
audit-verified-result.json has dedup_log array (empty if no dupes)
verdict_pre_fix computed per §4.8: CLEAN (total=0), ACCEPTABLE (CRITICAL=0, MAJOR≤5), NEEDS ATTENTION (CRITICAL=0 MAJOR>5, or CRITICAL 1-3), BROKEN (CRITICAL>3)
Report written to .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-verify/reports/devkit-audit-[date].md
All output files written to audit-devkit-verify directory (NOT audit-devkit-scan)
verify-status.json updated to status: 'completed' at end
Finding IDs use correct prefixes per phase: F-XRF- (crossref), F-WFL- (workflow), F-CON- (consistency), F-MPV- (master plan)

evals.expected_output: Chỉ chạy Phase 0 (load) + Phase 1 (4 cross-ref passes). Tạo 4 findings-crossref-*.json files. Stops sau Phase 1. Không chạy workflow/consistency/master-plan phases. Mini-summary hiển thị per-pass findings count. Verdict tính chỉ trên crossref findings.

assertions.text: verify-status.json scope is set to 'crossref' (not 'all')
4 findings-crossref-*.json files created in audit-devkit-verify/[session]/
No findings-workflow.json created
No findings-consistency.json created
No findings-masterplan-verify.json created
No audit-verified-result.json created (full merge not run)
verify-status.json completed_phases includes phase0-load and phase1-pass-a through phase1-pass-d
verify-status.json pending_phases is empty (scope completed)
Mini-summary displayed with per-pass findings count
Verdict computed and displayed based on crossref findings only

evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-verify --master-plan — chỉ chạy Master Plan Components verification (Phase 3.5)
evals.expected_output: Chỉ chạy Phase 0 (load) + Phase 3.5 (V1-V6 checks). Kiểm tra master_plan_components trong audit-index.json. Nếu tất cả NOT_FOUND → skip với log. Nếu có component deployed → chạy V1-V5 song song, V6 sau. Creates findings-masterplan-verify.json.

assertions.text: verify-status.json scope is set to 'master-plan' (not 'all')
Phase 1 (crossref), Phase 2 (workflow), Phase 3 (consistency) are NOT run
Phase 3.5 checks master_plan_components in audit-index.json
If all master_plan_components are NOT_FOUND → findings-masterplan-verify.json has empty findings array with skip_reason
If components exist → V1-V6 checks run with appropriate trigger conditions
findings-masterplan-verify.json created with $schema: 'audit-findings-v1'
Master Plan Components Verify Summary table displayed with V1-V6 status
verify-status.json completed_phases includes phase3_5-master-plan
Verdict computed based on master plan findings only

evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-verify --resume — tiếp tục từ checkpoint khi session trước bị gián đoạn giữa Phase 1
evals.expected_output: Reads existing verify-status.json, identifies completed phases/passes, continues from pending phases. Không re-run completed passes. Loads existing findings-crossref-*.json thay vì regenerate. Final merge includes findings from both old and new phases.

assertions.text: Skill reads .mc-data/work/audit-devkit-verify/[session]/verify-status.json to determine progress
Completed passes (in completed_phases) are NOT re-run
Existing findings-crossref-*.json files from completed passes are loaded
Pending passes are executed and new findings files created/updated
verify-status.json is updated progressively as phases complete
Final audit-verified-result.json includes findings from both old and new phases
verify-status.json updated to status: 'completed' at end

evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-verify — chạy nhưng scan prerequisites không tồn tại (audit-index.json missing)
evals.expected_output: PRE-GATE fails. Stops immediately. Hiển thị error E001: 'PRE-GATE fail — audit-index.json không tồn tại. STOP — chạy /audit-devkit-scan trước.' Không tạo findings files. Không tiếp tục phases.

assertions.text: Skill detects missing audit-index.json during Phase 0 PRE-GATE
Error E001 is displayed to user with clear instruction to run /audit-devkit-scan first
No work directory created or only empty directory
No findings files created
verify-status.json NOT created (or created with status indicating failure)
Skill does NOT attempt to continue to Phase 1 or later phases

evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-verify — chạy nhưng audit-index.json thiếu trường master_plan_components (scan chạy trước v1.1)
evals.expected_output: Phase 0 load bình thường. Phase 3.5 phát hiện audit-index.json không có master_plan_components → log WARNING E014: 'audit-index.json không có master_plan_components — scan có thể chạy trước v1.1. Phase 3.5 skipped.' Tiếp tục Phase 4 mà không có master plan findings. findings-masterplan-verify.json tạo rỗng với skip_reason.

assertions.text: Phase 0 loads audit-index.json successfully despite missing master_plan_components field
Warning E014 is logged: audit-index.json missing master_plan_components, Phase 3.5 skipped
findings-masterplan-verify.json created with empty findings array and skip_reason field
Phase 4 continues without master plan findings (from_master_plan = 0)
audit-verified-result.json master_plan_verify.skipped = true with skip_reason
Pipeline completes successfully — missing field is non-blocking

evals.prompt: /audit-devkit-verify — chạy nhưng spot-check phát hiện >20% files đã bị xóa/đổi tên since scan (E005)
evals.expected_output: Phase 0 spot-check (step 0.8) phát hiện <4/5 files vẫn tồn tại → WARNING E005. Hiển thị warning cho user: 'Scan data có thể stale (>20% files đã thay đổi). Khuyến nghị: chạy lại /audit-devkit-scan.' Verify tiếp tục nhưng log warnings. verify-status.json chứa warnings[].

assertions.text: Spot-check step 0.8 detects >20% files missing/renamed
Warning E005 displayed to user with recommendation to re-run scan
Warnings are logged in verify-status.json
Verify continues execution (does not STOP) — stale data is a warning, not blocking
Findings may note 'file may have been moved or deleted since scan'

evals.expected_output: Chỉ chạy Phase 0 (load) + Phase 1 focused crossref (skip passes A-D) + Phase 2 (workflow chỉ check handoffs liên quan wf-design) + Phase 3 (consistency chỉ check wf-design naming). Skip Phase 3.5 (master plan). Tạo 1 findings-crossref-wf-design.json với checks: _contract.json cross-ref, output path alignment với 00-core.md §4b, downstream/upstream skill references. verify-status.json scope='skill', focused_skill='wf-design'.

assertions.text: verify-status.json scope is set to 'skill' and focused_skill is set to 'wf-design'
Phase 0 loads and validates scan results normally
Phase 1 runs focused crossref only (1.F.1–1.F.8) — skip full passes A, B, C, D
findings-crossref-wf-design.json created with $schema: 'audit-findings-v1' and category field (functional/structural)
Focused crossref checks: _contract.json produces_for/consumes_from match SKILL.md paths, output paths exist in 00-core.md §4b, template refs exist on disk
Phase 2 workflow check only traces handoffs involving wf-design (not all skills)
Phase 3 consistency check only checks wf-design naming (not all skills)
Phase 3.5 master plan verification is SKIPPED
Phase 4 merge produces audit-verified-result.json with focused findings only
verify-status.json completed_phases includes phase0-load, phase1-focused-crossref, phase2-workflow, phase3-consistency, phase4-merge
verify-status.json does NOT include phase1-pass-a through phase1-pass-d or phase3_5-master-plan
verify-status.json status is 'completed' at end
